description: Multi-phase plans currently in flight. Each phase references roadmap item ids; the activePhase section breaks the current phase into concrete tasks with status. Survives conversation compactions — a fresh session can pick up by reading this file.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.notes: Schema, bus, episodic memory, agent base. Nothing alive yet — just the substrate everything else hangs off.

phases.title: First Voice
phases.notes: Cheshire Cat end-to-end. Talking to himself. Layered context composer + engagement policy + ADR writer come online here because the Cat is their first consumer.

phases.title: First Tension
phases.notes: Add the White Rabbit. Two voices, role tension, semantic + relational memory layers populated as the agents accumulate history. Compaction-as-behavior arrives because it has to.

phases.title: First Race
phases.notes: Dodo orchestrator + quiescence + conflict resolution + first showcase (/health endpoint). The system runs end-to-end on a trivial directive. Init CLI lands here so the showcase can run against a real target project.

phases.title: Full Cast
phases.notes: Bring the rest of the cast online with integration tests per agent. Per-character artifact handlers for the new speech act payloads. Synthetic-consensus guard goes here because it only matters once disagreement is real.

phases.title: Real Threads
phases.notes: The hard showcases — translation chat MVP, security recovery, multi-session persistence. Transcript annotation tooling lets us publish them. Token telemetry confirms the engagement_policy is paying for itself.

phases.title: Evals
phases.notes: Generic-baseline vs Wonderland comparison. The compounding-curve plot is the legibility-of-value mitigation from §11. Without this the philosophy stays assertion.

activePhase.title: Foundation
activePhase.goal: Lay the substrate so the Cheshire Cat can come online in P2 without retrofitting any plumbing. By end of P1, an empty WonderlandAgent subclass should be able to subscribe to the Caucus, observe utterances, persist them episodically, and call Anthropic with a cached prompt prefix — even if it has nothing to say yet.
activePhase.sequencing: Schema first (utterance + identity), because every other piece references those types. Then the bus, then storage, then the LLM client, then the agent base that ties them together. Repo skeleton happens before any of it. Each step has its own tests; we don't move on until the previous primitive can be exercised in isolation.

tasks.title: Repo skeleton: pyproject + src layout + tooling
tasks.details: Init pyproject.toml (Python 3.12+, hatchling). src/wonderland package layout. Add deps: anthropic, redis, pydantic, ulid-py, aiosqlite, pytest, pytest-asyncio, ruff. Configure ruff for lint+format. Pre-commit optional. README stub pointing to WONDERLAND_SPEC.md.
tasks.resolution: pyproject.toml with hatchling backend, Python 3.12+ floor (3.13 dev pin via .python-version). src/wonderland package layout with __init__.py and py.typed marker. Deps installed via uv: anthropic 0.98, redis 7.4, pydantic 2.13, python-ulid 3.1, aiosqlite 0.22. Dev: pytest 9.0, pytest-asyncio 1.3 (asyncio_mode=auto), ruff 0.15. Ruff lint selects E/W/F/I/B/UP/N/SIM/RUF; format uses double quotes. Smoke test passing. README stub points to WONDERLAND_SPEC.md and notes the .wonderland/ vs wonderland-ai/ separation. Substituted python-ulid for ulid-py — same import surface, more actively maintained. .gitignore added; repo not yet git-initialized.

tasks.title: Utterance + speech-act + sub-type schemas
tasks.details: src/wonderland/utterance.py — Pydantic v2 models. Utterance, SpeechAct (Literal), AgentIdentity, Stance, AffectVector, Artifact. ULID id default factory. Frozen where it makes sense. Round-trip JSON tests.
tasks.resolution: src/wonderland/utterance.py with Pydantic v2 models. SpeechAct StrEnum (17 values) + SUBSTANTIVE_ACTS/PROCEDURAL_ACTS frozensets + is_substantive/is_procedural predicates — categorization is data, not type, since the directive-relay carve-out makes type-level enforcement wrong. AffectVector option 3: arousal/valence/urgency in [-1,1] + extras dict for character-specific axes. AgentIdentity (name + constitution_version), Stance (in/out/meta), Artifact (kind discriminator + flexible payload — per-kind validation deferred to P5 handlers), UtteranceContent (body+artifacts), Utterance (frozen, ULID id default, UTC timestamp default, confidence in [0,1] default 1.0). 33 tests pass + smoke; ruff clean; round-trip JSON verified.

tasks.title: Identity dataclass + constitution loader
tasks.details: src/wonderland/identity.py — Identity (name, version, constitution_text, interests: set[SpeechAct], engagement_policy callable). Loader reads constitutions/<name>.md (already exist for cat, rabbit, hatter, alice, dodo). YAML frontmatter parsing if/when constitutions adopt it; otherwise plain markdown body. Tests load all five existing constitutions.
tasks.resolution: src/wonderland/identity.py with Identity dataclass + ConstitutionHeader + load_constitution + parse_constitution_header. Header parser reads H1 display name + bold-key lines (Role/Lineage/License/optional Pair) until first --- separator, so body templates with **Status:** etc. don't contaminate the header. Version extracted from 'Wonderland v0.X' lineage. The Tweedle pair protocol is correctly rejected — it has Lineage and License but no Role, and the parser names that as the failure mode. EngagementPolicy aliased as Callable[[Utterance, AgentMemory|None], bool]; AgentMemory is a Protocol stub awaiting T5. default_engagement_policy(interests) returns a closure that engages iff act in interests. Identity.should_engage uses the supplied policy or the default. as_agent_identity() bridges to the bus-side AgentIdentity from utterance.py. 27 identity tests; 61 total pass; ruff clean.

tasks.title: Caucus event bus over Redis Streams
tasks.details: src/wonderland/caucus.py — Caucus class. publish(utterance) -> stream entry id. subscribe(interests, thread_id=None) -> async iterator of Utterance. Per-thread XADD to a thread-scoped stream key. Consumer groups for multi-agent fan-out. Local InMemoryCaucus stub for tests so we don't need Redis in CI for unit work.
tasks.resolution: src/wonderland/caucus.py with Caucus protocol + RedisCaucus + InMemoryCaucus. Single global stream per project (DEFAULT_STREAM='wonderland:utterances'); thread_id and interests filter client-side after deserialization, keeping the bus generic. RedisCaucus uses XADD for publish, XREADGROUP with per-agent consumer groups for subscribe (agents share position when they share a name; can rebalance when we add multi-instance). Always-ack policy on read: filtered messages are still acked so they don't get redelivered — filtering is the subscriber's choice, not a queueing concern. InMemoryCaucus registers queues *synchronously* on subscribe() so a subscriber created before publish() is guaranteed to receive it without create_task choreography in tests; asyncio is single-threaded and there are no awaits between read/write of _subscribers, so no lock is needed. Redis tests are gated behind WONDERLAND_REDIS_URL env var; no local Redis available so the production path stays unverified at runtime — exercised through code review until CI provides Redis. 11 caucus tests + 1 skipped Redis smoke; 74 total pass; ruff clean.

tasks.title: Episodic memory store
tasks.details: src/wonderland/memory/episodic.py — EpisodicStore wrapping aiosqlite. record(utterance), query_by_thread(thread_id), query_by_speaker(name), query_by_other_agent(name) (utterances I observed *from* X). Path resolved from project_root + agent_name. Migration stub for future schema changes.
tasks.resolution: src/wonderland/memory/episodic.py + src/wonderland/memory/__init__.py — per-agent SQLite log of observed/produced utterances at <project_root>/.wonderland/memory/<agent>/episodic.sqlite. Schema v1: utterances table with id/thread_id/parent_id/speaker_name/speaker_version/speech_act/timestamp/payload columns; payload is the full Utterance JSON for lossless replay; indexed columns enable cheap thread/speaker/speech_act queries. schema_meta sidecar table records SCHEMA_VERSION=1 — future migrations branch on the recorded version. record() uses INSERT OR IGNORE on id, so bus redelivery is idempotent and not a bug. query_by_thread / query_by_speaker / query_by_other_agent (alias of by_speaker for semantic clarity at call sites). Async context manager + explicit open/close. Per-agent isolation: separate paths, no cross-agent reads through this layer (the bus is the cross-agent surface). 18 episodic tests (lifecycle, persistence, idempotency, query semantics, concurrent records); 94 total pass; ruff clean.

tasks.title: Anthropic client wrapper with cache breakpoints
tasks.details: src/wonderland/llm.py — thin wrapper around anthropic SDK. complete(messages, system, cache_breakpoints) -> response. Default model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Token accounting hook (callback per call). Cache_control inserted at the breakpoints we pass. Tests mock the SDK; one optional smoke test gated by env var.
tasks.resolution: src/wonderland/llm.py — LLMClient wrapping anthropic.AsyncAnthropic. Default model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 per D-005; max_tokens default 4096. complete(*, system, messages, max_tokens, **extra) returns CompletionResult(text, stop_reason, usage, raw). System parts are list[str | CachedBlock]: CachedBlock items become {type:'text', text:..., cache_control:{type:'ephemeral'}} blocks for the Anthropic prompt cache; plain strs become uncached text blocks. The Anthropic API caches every prefix up to the rightmost cached block, so two CachedBlocks (constitution + relationships) means both prefixes are individually cacheable. on_token_usage callback fires after every successful call with TokenUsage(input/output/cache_creation/cache_read tokens) — wired this way so the eval harness in P7 gets per-request cost telemetry without the agent loop needing to know about it. Anthropic client lazily constructed if not injected (no API-key requirement at LLMClient instantiation). 15 mocked tests + 1 env-gated live smoke (WONDERLAND_LLM_SMOKE=1 + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). 109 total pass; ruff clean.

tasks.title: WonderlandAgent base class
tasks.details: src/wonderland/agent.py — base class wiring identity + memory + caucus + llm. listen()/speak() loops per spec §5. should_engage delegating to identity. compose_context stub returning the layered prompt skeleton (P2 fills in the layers). deliberate stub. Returning None must be supported (silence).
